summary: Exhaustive file-by-file deep map of the entire Petascale enhancement, dashboard integration, and Systems Ready Plan implementation. Covers 100+ files across ops/, server/services/, server/routes/, server/security/, shared/admin/, k8s/, scripts/loadtest/. Every file is annotated with its role, what it wires to, which enhancement iteration produced it, and what metrics/endpoints it consumes or emits. Includes architecture mermaid diagram, enhancement timeline, and cross-reference tables for another agent to audit the complete system.
